notes.title: 🚀 Demo Update: Major Improvements Based on Your Feedback!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

A huge thank you to everyone who checked out the demo over the past day! Your feedback has been incredibly valuable, and we’ve already rolled out a bunch of fixes and improvements based on your experiences. Here’s what’s new:

🔧 Key Changes & Fixes:
✅ Reworked Main Menu – Cleaner design, smoother navigation.
✅ Single-Player Markers – Now it’s clear which character you’re controlling!
✅ Fixed Jump Inputs – No more accidental double jumps.
✅ Music Bug Squashed – No more sudden silences or glitches.
✅ Adjusted Map Difficulty – The original layout was too punishing, so we’ve tweaked it for better pacing.
✅ Added More Safe Points – Less frustration, more progress!

Your feedback is directly shaping the game, so please keep it coming! If you haven’t tried the demo yet, now’s the perfect time—updates are live!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3744000/Steal_The_Pig_Demo/]👉 Play the Demo Here 👈[/url]
Found a bug? Have suggestions? Join our Discord and let us know! We read every message.
[url=https://discord.gg/7mHw7Qa7B4]🔗 Join Our Discord[/url]
What’s next? More polish, more content, and your suggestions. Let us know what you’d like to see improved!

Thanks for playing
